title: Snow Rider 3D
description:
Owned by Ashima Prabhakar, email id : superapps25@gmail.com

Would you like to ride on a sleigh? Then, no need to go anywhere. Because now, you can experience riding a sleigh for free anytime you want in Snow Rider 3D. Although you are not actually on a sleigh, you will feel like you’re actually riding one because the game is in 3D. Try to go as far as you can to get high score. You may also collect gifts to purchase sleigh.

title: Geometry Arrow
description: Dive into an exhilarating journey through a treacherous cave! Your mission: reach the portal at the end of each level while avoiding deadly spikes and obstacles. With six progressively harder levels, you’ll need sharp reflexes and spot-on timing to survive. Can you conquer every challenge and make it out of the cave? Put your skills to the test in this high-speed action game!

title: Geometry Arrow 2
description: Geometry Arrow 2 is the fast-paced sequel to the original rhythm arcade hit! Navigate through 6 dynamic levels, dodging obstacles that move to the beat. Switch between the Arrow and the all-new Wheel character, each with unique mechanics. Unlock achievements and customize your Arrow and Wheel with different skins, particles, and block textures. Time your moves, feel the rhythm, and reach the portal in perfect sync!

title: Jump Dash
description:
Leap, soar, and survive in this fast-paced rhythm platformer!
Step into the intense world of Jump Dash, where every move must be perfectly timed. Test your reflexes as you jump, glide, and flip through treacherous levels packed with spikes, traps, and relentless obstacles.

title: Jetpack Heroes
description: Jetpack heroes – an exciting game of skill, the main task is to go as far as possible without crashing into obstacles on the hero’s path, collect coins, fuel, boost, bombs, exclusive items and much more. Let’s play!

title: Vex 9
description:
Vex 9 is here- the next evolution in the legendary stickman platformer series! Take your parkour skills to the limit as you run, jump, and slide your way through a brand-new set of Acts filled with dangerous traps, bombs, and other deadly surprises. 

For the first time ever, take to the skies with the powerful new Jetpack! Put your reflexes to the ultimate test in the all-new Challenge Mode! Can you conquer every challenge and become the ultimate Vex champion?

title: Wave Dash : Geometry Arrow
description: Ride the wave in Wave Dash, a rhythm platformer where each tap steers your arrow through tight corridors. Read patterns in waves, time jumps to music, and beat brutal stages. Build routes with the level editor, share creations, unlock icons, chase ranks, and perfect speed runs. Simple controls, fast restarts—pure focus and flow. Inspired by classic geometry platformers, tuned for dash mastery.

title: Geometry Vibes 3D
description: Geometry Vibes 3D takes everything you loved about the original Geometry Vibes and brings it into a vibrant, dynamic 3D world. With fully reimagined levels and stunning new visuals, this version elevates your reflexes and rhythm-based skills to new dimensions.

title: Geometry Vibes X-Arrow
description: Geometry Vibes X Arrow is the newest evolution of the Geometry Vibes series, offering the most refined, competitive and customizable arrow experience so far. The goal is simple but demanding: guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths, survive increasingly difficult patterns and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything.

title: Vex Hyper Dash
description:
Get ready for a fast-paced challenge in this brand-new Vex spin-off: Vex Hyper Dash! Inspired by the legendary Geometry Dash. Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible. Jump from platform to platform, time your moves perfectly, and avoid the countless dangers that stand in your way. One wrong move, one mistimed jump, and it’s game over. 

Vex Hyper Dash puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Can you master the flow and set a new high score?

title: 67 Clicker Tap Tap
description: 67 Clicker is a fast, funny, and highly addictive meme clicker game where every tap brings you closer to unlocking a strange and unforgettable collection of 67-themed characters. Your goal is simple at first: click or tap to earn 67 Points, spend them on upgrades, and keep growing your power. The ultimate objective is to reach the final upgrade, The 67 Galaxy, and unlock all 14 unique 67 characters waiting across the journey.

title: Obby Highest Jump Ever
description:
Obby Highest Jump Ever is a click-based jumping and climbing game where every click makes you stronger. Start from a small 10M building and push your way up to massive 2500M towers as your jump power grows step by step. Each new height feels like a new milestone, and every rooftop trophy proves you earned it.

Your goal is simple: jump higher, reach the top, and collect trophies. The higher the building, the bigger the reward.

title: Hidden Pairs Mahjong
description: Match and clear all the tile in this Hidden Pairs Mahjong solitaire game. Use your observation skills to find and select identical open tiles to remove them from the board. With beautifully designed classic Mahjong symbols, smooth animations, and a calming background, each level offers a fresh puzzle challenge.Earn bonus time, increase your score, and progress through endless levels of tile-matching fun!

title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
description: Enchanted Mahjong Saga is a fast-paced twist on the classic tile-matching game, with unlimited levels to challenge your mind. Match tiles, beat the clock, and keep your streak alive as each level gets tougher and more exciting. Feeling stuck? Use helpful hints to get back on track and stay in the game.Whether youre playing for a quick break or settling in for a longer session, theres always a new puzzle waiting.

title: Crazy Tunnel
description: Crazy Tunnel is a fast-paced, first-person arcade game. Navigate through the tunnel at breakneck speeds and aim for the longest distance possible.

title: Slicer Duo
description: Slicer Duo is a satisfying ASMR game where precision, timing, and rhythm come together in a sharp slicing adventure. Move through level-based stages, cut through fruits and all kinds of objects, collect points, and try to keep your knife in motion for as long as possible. While the controls are simple, every section demands focus because one bad move can send your knife straight into danger.

title: Number Rush
description:
You can absorb smaller or equal numbers while avoiding obstacles.
If you collide with a number bigger than you, it's game over.
Make the largest number possible to break through the wall and get the treasure chest~!

title: Machine City Balls
description: Machine City Balls is a ball parkour game. A must play game for those who like challenges. Collect rare balls and complete all ball game challenges to become a winner! Are you ready? Start your parkour journey now!

title: Snow Rider 3D nostalgia
description: Snow Rider 3D: Nostalgia brings back the beloved old version of the iconic sleigh-riding game — the same thrilling ride, relaxing snow tracks, and joyful music that started it all.

title: Riders Downhill Racing
description: Get ready to join the riders in an exciting adventure with Riders Downhill Racing! Choose from various game modes, including free ride, race, and career, available in both 1 player and 2 player modes. Experience the thrill of riding different vehicles, such as ATV bikes, cross bikes, and speed boats, while wearing different costumes. Join any mode and have a blast! Remember to collect diamonds during the free ride to unlock more items.

title: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker
description: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker is a fast, satisfying idle clicker built around one of the internet’s newest chaotic obsessions: the “Goo Goo Gaga” meme. Goo Goo Gaga Clicker takes the addictive, dopamine-fueled mechanics of Brainrot Clicker and gives them a surreal makeover.  What starts as a simple tap session quickly turns into a full-on collection grind where every click pushes you closer to the next weird, iconic form!

title: VEX Challenges
description:
Put your skills to the test in Vex Challenges, the newest online Vex game where the timer counts down instead of up. Try to get to the finish within the allotted time, and don’t forget to pick up the stars on the way!

Vex Challenges is just as gripping and thrilling as before, but includes a brand new way to play. The game includes 75 custom levels, a hidden Challenge Mode, new skins and a soundtrack that evolves as you progress. It’s Vex like you’ve never seen before!

title: Vex Try To Fly
description: Vex Try To Fly is a fast-paced launch adventure where your goal is simple: send Vex as far as possible! Blast out of a cannon, collect powerful boosts like jump potions, jetpacks, and portals, and use bounce platforms and wind to keep Vex in the air. Avoid dangerous obstacles, upgrade everything, and improve every run. Master the slam ability, fly farther than ever before, and discover how far Vex can go!

title: Ball Rolling Slope
description:
Navigate a rolling ball through endless neon slopes in the Ball Rolling Slope game! Test your reflexes, dodge obstacles, and aim for the highest score in this challenge.
Ball Rolling Slope game is an exhilarating 3D arcade game that puts your reflexes and precision to the ultimate test. Guide a rolling ball down a steep, neon-lit slope filled with challenging obstacles and sudden drops. The gameplay is simple to pick up but difficult to master.

title: 3Dash
description: 3Dash is a fast-paced 3D rhythm platformer inspired by Geometry Dash—dash, jump, and flip through dizzying, rotating tracks while keeping perfect time. Tackle six hand-crafted levels, then build your own with the level editor for endless replay

title: Fast Ball Jump
description: Let’s prepare yourself to feel happy and relaxed by playing going balls. Roll, spin, jump and don’t lose lives because unexpected obstacles lie ahead. Get ready & participate in an epic roll ball race in a different environment. You will have a lot of fun in your spare time by playing green ball run 2048 and journey ball sky.

title: Travel Mahjong Deluxe
description: Travel Mahjong Deluxe is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle where you match identical tiles and strategically clear the board. Find pairs of beautiful travel-themed tiles that are free on at least one side and remove them to complete each level. As you progress, new layouts and challenges will keep the game fresh and engaging. Use the Hint feature whenever you get stuck, or watch a reward video to gain unlimited time and continue your puzzle-solving adventure.

title: Geometry Missile
description: Navigate your missile through challenging geometric obstacle courses! Control a triangular missile that automatically flies forward while you tap to guide it up and down. Avoid collisions with various shapes like triangles, rectangles, and spikes to reach the gate at each level's end. Test your reflexes in this fast-paced arcade adventure!

title: X to Y: Almost Impossible!
description: X to Y is a fast-paced precision platform skill game focused on timing, reflexes, and speed control. Guide X through dangerous obstacles, traps, and tight spaces to reach Y. Every move requires perfect acceleration and sharp reactions — one mistake and you fail. Earn up to 3 stars per level to unlock new worlds, including dark mode challenges, auto-movement stages, and physics-based puzzles.

title: Float for Brainrots
description: Float for Brainrots is a chaotic water adventure game where you collect rare Brainrots across dangerous seas. Start with a simple raft, unlock powerful boats, upgrade speed and capacity, and explore deeper waters for better rewards. Manage your timer, avoid sharks, and use islands to survive. Play solo or with a friend in 2 player mode and build your ultimate Brainrot collection.

title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
description:
Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem is an exciting motorcycle racing game. 
In this game you will become a motorcycle racer who travels through city streets and highways, avoiding collisions with other vehicles. You will be able to unlock faster and more powerful motorcycles, each with its own unique handling characteristics, as well as improve the characteristics of your motorcycle. One of the key features of the game is a realistic physics engine that makes the gameplay challenging and exciting.

title: Capybara Jump
description: Bounce into a cute stacking challenge with Capybara Jump! Time your taps to leap as wooden blocks slide in from both sides, building a towering platform under your capybara. Land perfectly to chain combos, trigger sparkles, and push your score higher before a mistimed jump sends you tumbling down.

title: Hyper Wave Challenge
description: Control the Wave, avoid obstacles, collect coins, and reach the end of each level. Every level features dangerous obstacles that require precision and dexterity, while portals keep the gameplay engaging.

title: 67 Clicker
description:
Forget everything you know about gaming. Experience the absolute peak of interactive entertainment. It’s not just a number; it’s a lifestyle. Tap the 67 and watch your empire grow.

FULLY AUTOMATED STONKS: Buy upgrades to make the 67 click itself. It’s literally free real estate.

PEAK BRAIN ROT: No thoughts, just 67. The perfect idle experience for fans of "number go up" simulators.

title: Skillful Finger
description: Touch the screen and slide your finger along the glowing line without lifting it. Avoid barriers, stay clear of the edges, and react quickly as the speed increases. Customize your ball and tail, face dynamic obstacles, and enjoy endlessly generated paths that keep every run fast, challenging, and addictive.

title: Geometry Platformer
description: Geometry Platformer is a fast-paced, reflex-testing platformer where players guide a shape-shifting cube through a series of dangerous geometric obstacles. The game features sharp spikes, swinging hazards, and gravity-defying mechanics that challenge your timing and precision. The neon graphics and intense gameplay create a thrilling experience, requiring quick reactions and memorization of complex patterns.

title: Arrow Wave
description: Explore a world where a wave moves through various obstacles, overcoming challenges along the way. Test your reaction and perseverance!

title: Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls
description:
Fire Ball and Water Ball: Parkour Love Balls is an interesting parkour adventure and addictive ball game in the platform genre where orange fire ball and blue water ball running races. 

Help orange ball to get to the portal faster than the blue ball doing parkour tricks! The game is similar to mario.

Game Features:
- Multiple levels with colorful balls
- Various biomes
- Secrets in the back
- Orange fire and blue water ball skins
- The water ball girl goes through the levels with you!

title: 2-3-4 Player Games
description: These games can be played with 2, 3, or 4 players. You can play 21 unique games with your friends, each with different scenarios. The objective of each game is to either score or be the first to reach the finish line. Move swiftly and outpace your opponents! It's time to enjoy with friends!

title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
description: Designed for those who love ball games with realistic physics and elements, the goal of this game is to roll to the finish line without falling into the water. Master the control of the ball and collect coins on your route to unlock new balls, tail tracks and sky packages. You can play the game in 1 player mode or 2 player racing mode. Enjoy realistic nature, physics and effects in dozens of different levels!

title: Red Light Green Light
description: Step into the thrilling world of Red Light Green Light, a fast-paced and addictive game inspired by the classic playground challenge! Test your reflexes, strategy, and timing as you race against others to reach the finish line without getting caught.

title: Muscle Challenge
description: Run, eat healthy foods and proteins and avoid harmful foods, drinks and obstacles in the Muscle Challenge game! Defeat your enemies with the strength and muscular body you gained at the end of the race! The enemies get stronger in each level, so you have to get better too... If you want, you can also play the game in challenge mode with your friend in 2 Player mode.

title: Thrill Roller Coaster
description: Thrill Roller Coaster is a fun 3D roller coaster simulator game. Press and hold to accelerate forward, your speed and acceleration is fast enough for you to reach the other end of the track. Watch out for the brakes in the middle and drive the roller coaster at breakneck speeds now! Experience speed and passion!

title: Stand on the Right Color, Robby!
description: “Stand on the Right Color, Robby!” is a fast arcade race on shifting colored tiles. React to color changes, jump from tile to tile, and stay on the right color to avoid falling. Beat rivals to the finish, earn currency, and unlock fun Robby skins, items, and effects as you climb the leaderboard!

title: Carnage Battle Arena
description:
Get Carnage now and discover a new kind of racing game! Driving fast and getting to the finish line is only one of the multiple challenges that await you. Wreak havoc on the streets thanks to the extensive destruction model that lets you not only damage vehicles, but also cause visible changes in the environment. After a long battle, the location will look nothing like it used to at the start!

Whichever mode you choose, get ready for loads of adrenaline-pumping action! Play Carnage now!

title: Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash
description:
Italian Brainrot in Geometry Dash:
Explore a world where a geometric wave rushes through crazy obstacles, overcoming challenges one after another. Rhythm, chaos, and a splash of Italian madness — test your reaction and endurance in this geometric trial!

On different levels, you’ll encounter various Italian Brainrot animals: Tralalero Tralala, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, Lirili Larila.

title: Noob: parkour tricks
description:
Welcome to Noob: Parkour tricks!

This is a runner and timekiller in the minecraft universe about the adventures of Noob. Do parkour tricks and complete challenges.

Monster School kicked out Noob, and Herobrine turned him into a Gigachad!

Game Features:
- Run through the village with trials.
- Do parkour tricks.
- Complete challenges and avoid traps.
- Collect diamonds.
- Unlock new skins.

title: Stack Fall
description:
Smash the floor! 
Are you under stress? Maybe Stack Fall can help you to release the stress. 
As your ball keep breaking the floors to get to the goal, every smashing will ease your stress. 
It's time to break some stacks!

title: Wave Road 3D
description: Wave Road 3D is a fast-paced reflex game that challenges your focus, timing, and precision. You control a sleek arrow gliding through a floating road filled with gears, traps, and collectible gems. Whether you’re chasing high scores in endless mode, conquering 20 handcrafted levels in classic mode, or racing head-to-head with a friend in 2 player mode, Wave Road 3D offers a refreshing and dynamic experience.

title: Drunken Fighters
description:
Are you ready for an adrenaline-filled fighting adventure?

Step into the ring in Drunken Fighters’ single-player mode and face opponents that will test your reflexes, or grab a friend and fight in two-player mode on the same device.

Master ragdoll physics and boost the thrill with Funny Mod options: Stretch Kick, Stretch Punch, Big Punch, Super Punch, and Big Head or let Random Mode surprise you with chaos!

title: Devil Duck : Not a Troll Game
description: Devil Duck is an action-packed platformer game that challenges players to navigate through treacherous levels teeming with danger. Set in the fiery depths of the Devil's Domain, you play as a fearless adventurer on a quest to reclaim stolen treasures guarded by the sinister Devil King.

title: Hidden Object Rooms Exploration
description: Explore a variety of rooms and find hidden items! With 18 levels and 6 items to discover in each room, enjoy the thrill of searching through different spaces like living rooms and more. Drag the screen to explore them. Get ready for an exciting adventure in 'Hidden Object Rooms Exploration'!

title: Dogs Spot The Differences
description: Immerse yourself in the charming world of 'Dogs: Spot the Differences,' a puzzle game featuring scenes filled with adorable companions. Challenge your observation skills, uncover subtle differences, and unlock new levels. With stunning visuals and escalating challenges, become a detective in a captivating journey of discovery and fun. Can you spot them all and become the ultimate enthusiast for your lovable companions?

title: Winter Differences
description: Welcome to Winter Differences, a captivating spot-the-difference puzzle game! Challenge your observational skills as you seek out the distinctions between two nearly identical images. Put your hawk eyes to the test and tap the differences you spot, or use hints when needed. Remember, any unused hints and saved time will boost your bonus score. Enjoy the challenge and dive into the world of Winter Differences!

title: Dont Tap
description: Don't tap condenses the basic idea of ground breaking game hits like rock band or guitar hero into a simple yet genius free online game that you can enjoy, whether you play on your phone, a tablet or on your desktop.

title: Xmas Magic Tiles
description: Try to tap on the green tiles without missing any A fun Christmas themed music game

title: Sniper Elite 3D
description: Prepare to enjoy the finest 3D sniper experience ever with the most thrilling and action-packed shooting game! Sniper 3D is the ultimate free gun game that immerses you in the life of a lethal assassin. Immerse yourself in high-intensity offline missions and test your shooting abilities in this adrenaline-fueled sniper experience. Have fun playing Sniper Elite 3D, a free online game!

title: Yes or No Challenge Run
description: This time you will not only run over the platforms and pass through the gates for the next version of yours, but you will also answer questions and earn rewards. Yes or No Challenge Run game comes with lots of features, surprises, and cool questions! Some helper machines or pets will be with you during this adventure. You can embark on this Yes or No adventure either single-player or 2 player. Pick your game mode and let the adventure start!

title: Noob in Geometry Dash
description: Move to the rhythm and help Nubik navigate challenging levels! Collect keys to unlock skins, complete courses, and see how high you can rank among the best players. Step into the beat-driven adventure!

title: Offroad Life 3D
description: A life on the mountains with huge vehicles with huge wheels is beginning with the Offroad Life 3D game! This adventure will be in the different places of the world under the different seasons from autumn to summer. Various offroad vehicle options and various wheel options are available with this great adventure. Embark on this adventure with your friend in 2 player game mode and discover new areas together!

title: Drift Donut
description: Drift into action with this exhilarating 3D car drifting game! Master the art of drifting as you take control of a variety of cars and navigate through uniquely designed donut-shaped roads. The challenge is simple: click or tap to start drifting and keep your car on the road to earn points. With every donut road you clear, your score increases, challenging you to push your drifting skills to the limit.

title: Neon Dash: Cyber Run
description:
Neon Dash: Cyber Run is a high-speed endless runner set in a glowing cyber world.
Jump over deadly spikes, pass through portals to shift themes, and survive as
the game speed increases over time.

The game is designed for short, replayable sessions with instant restarts.
Perfect for both desktop and mobile players.

title: Geometry Rush
description: Geometry Rush will take you to a world of challenging and treacherous platforming. Are you ready to run through trap-filled passages, jump and dodge death? Learn from your mistakes, perfect your reflexes, master the path without a single slip and advance to the next level.

title: Snake King
description: Get ready to slither your way to the top in this addictive take on the classic Snake game! As the Snake King, you’ll navigate through a maze-like arena, avoiding collisions with the four walls and your own tail.

title: Spooky Chains
description: Spooky Chains is a fun Halloween puzzle game. Tap a tile and drag through matching nearby items to make a chain of 3 or more. The items vanish, and the tiles turn golden. Your goal is to turn all tiles golden. Sometimes a Flying Witch glides across the board. Tap her while she flies to watch a reward ad. After the ad, she blasts some tiles into golden. You can also watch a reward ad to remove the timer and play without time pressure.

title: Slope Emoji 2
description: Slope Emoji is a fantastic endless ball rolling game with many emoji balls. Guide a colorful cast of emoji characters down challenging slopes. Test your reflexes with endless series of obstacles, unexpected twists, and surprises. Collect Likes button for more new emoji characters with unique faces! Get ready for the ride of your life and master the art of ball rolling!

title: Sky Balls 3D
description: Sky Balls 3D invites you on an adventure as you travel through the sky with rolling balls and test your reaction skills. Keep the ball on the track without letting it fall and watch out for obstacles, traps and gaps! Collect coins and keys along the way to get new ball skins and sky-boxes. You can play the game in 1 player and 2 player modes.

title: Hole and Collect
description: Try to collect all the objects in the area with the cute black hole before the time runs out! Group them and destroy them with smart moves. You can buy new black holes with the money you earn.

title: Only Up Balls
description: An exciting journey begins as you try to reach the top! The aim of the Only Up Balls game is to get your ball to the roof of various platforms by jumping from the tracks. The game first starts with the "Noob" sections and allows you to learn the mechanics. Then prove your mastery level with the "Pro" and "Hacker" sections. Finally, push the limits with the "Extreme" section!

title: Thanksgiving Spot The Differences
description: Feast your eyes on our delectable Thanksgiving Spot the Difference game! Discover the subtle distinctions in these mouthwatering food portraits as you savor the holiday spirit. Test your appetite for detail and enjoy a savory challenge that celebrates the flavors of Thanksgiving!

title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2
description: Welcome to Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2. It's a test of your agility and intelligence as you guide the square through thrilling challenges. The game features six levels, each filled with tricky mazes. The cube will automatically rush forward at a fast pace, making it challenging to keep up. Your goal is to navigate through the obstacles in time. Jump over sharp spikes, leap onto platforms, and make use of the yellow boosters to soar even higher.

title: Candy Chain Master
description: Welcome to Candy Chain Master! The board has blue tiles with candies on them. Start by selecting a candy and move across nearby tiles with the same candy to make a chain of three or more. Each tile must turn golden by matching at least one candy on it. Think carefully and move fast to turn all tiles golden before time runs out.

title: Funny Mad Racing
description: This is the adventure of bouncy cars on the bouncy roads with the Funny Mad Racing game! The game consists of 40 levels various cars and various surprising funny features that you will encounter during your adventure. You can play this great and fun hill-climbing adventure in 2 player mode besides of 1 player mode. Earn coins and unlock new features. Challenge a friend and double your fun! Let the adventure begin in the pixel world!

title: Paw Clash
description: Paw Clash is an exciting party game where cute animals compete in fun challenges. Enjoy a variety of mini-games that test your skills and reflexes in colorful environments. With simple controls and increasing difficulty, Paw Clash offers endless fun for players of all ages.

title: FNF 2 Player
description:
FNF 2 Player allows two players to play at the same time. Players can compete with each other by choosing the characters they want. The difficulty level can be determined by the music, thus appealing to all types of players.

Game Modes: 

- Story Mode: You fight with new characters weekly.
- Freeplay Mode: You can play by choosing the song you want.
- 2 Player Mode: It's time to duel with your friend.

title: L.O.L. Surprise! O.M.G. B.B. Driver
description:
Help Neonlicious collect gifts for her friends, but watch out for the roadworks and other obstacles in L.O.L. Surprise! O.M.G.™ B.B. Driver. Keep an eye on your battery level! It depletes more quickly if you hit patches of bad road, but you can recharge by driving over the blue arrows.

Upgrade your car, unlock music tapes with official L.O.L. O.M.G. tunes, and make your way through the gift-filled levels.

title: Backflip Parkour
description: Become a real trickster in our new simulator of parkour madness Backflip Parkour! Have you ever wanted to perform crazy tricks? In our simulator, you can perform flips and backflips. Jumps from heights are not hard if you are playing our parkour madness simulator. Perform jumps from heights and make flips and backflips. You can learn basics of parkour mania in our jumps madness simulator.

title: Spooky Sort It
description: Spooky Sort It! is a mind-sharpening brain puzzle that challenges you to sort a variety of haunting balls into the right tubes. As you tackle these spectral twists and turns, you'll not only enhance your problem-solving skills but also find a delightful way to cope with stress and refresh your mind in the captivating world of spectral sorting.

title: Mystic Object Hunt
description: Welcome to 'Mystic Object Hunt,' a fifteen-level Hidden Object game. Explore ancient realms, discover hidden artifacts, and unravel secrets in dim chambers and ruins. Sharpen your skills, overcome challenges, and delve into the mysteries within each location. Get ready for a thrilling hunt!

title: Dangerous Speedway Cars
description:
Are you good at driving? This HD game will surely give you the thrills and excitement.
This game has Nerve Racking and Breathtaking obstacles and challenges, Then let's see what you got on passing through extreme obstacles.

title: Fruit Goals Match
description: Fruit Goals Match is a fun and strategic fruit-matching  puzzle game where you collect specific fruits to complete each mission within limited moves. Every level brings a new challenge, rewards smart planning, and keeps the gameplay endless. Earn extra moves through reward ads and see how far you can progress.

title: 1010 Elixir Alchemy
description: Enter the enchanting world of '1010 Elixir Alchemy', where strategic placement reigns supreme. Strategically place Tetris-style blocks on a 10x10 grid to collect Elixirs. Complete rows or columns to gather Elixirs. If the grid fills up with remaining Elixirs, it's game over. With 60 levels, master the art of alchemy in this addictive adventure!

title: Ballbeez
description:
Welcome to the colorful, relaxing and satisfying world of ballbeez.

Throw colorful ballbeez into cups, watch them grow with water and try to reach the top line. But watch out, they should stay inside the cup.

title: Arrow Hit
description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure in the virtual realm with "Arrow Hit," the ultimate arcade game that puts your archery skills to the test! Immerse yourself in a captivating world where precision, timing, and accuracy are the keys to victory.

title: Turbo Stars
description:
Hop on your skateboard and speed down the track in this wild and fast-paced racing game!

Zoom through a wide variety of exhilarating tracks and defeat your opponents!

Think fast to pick up items that will help you gain an advantage — or even pick up and throw your competitors if they get too close to you! 

Don’t forget to snatch coins and keys to unlock a whole bunch of awesome items, including power-ups, new objects to ride on, and gear for your character.

title: Leap and Avoid 2
description: Get ready for another thrilling journey with the white ball! "Leap and Avoid 2" brings new caves, lab levels, and fresh mechanics. Discover secret paths, collect coins, and unlock powerful bonuses like speed boosts and shields. Jump on white platforms, avoid black ones, and explore in all directions to find exits. The more coins you gather, the higher you rank. Compete with friends and uncover every hidden treasure!

title: Seafaring Memory Challenge
description: Set sail into the captivating depths of the ocean with Seafaring Memory Challenge! Match pairs of sea-themed icons in an endless array of levels. Test your memory skills as you uncover treasures like colorful fish, delicate sea shells, and sunken treasures. With no level limit, the adventure never ends, providing hours of entertainment. Stay sharp and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the waves!

title: Tiny Golf King
description: Simple, intuitive, fun and addicting. Make it to the top in Tiny Golf King! Complete more than 45 challenging levels and be the King of Tiny golf

title: Dirty Them All
description: Let's splash some dirt over the walking people near the road with this Dirty Them All game! Drive your car through the mud and splash it all around the other people. Let them chase you until the finish line. The more people chase, the more scores you get. Let this funny and entertaining adventure begin!

title: Pixel Demolisher Cannon
description: In Pixel Demolisher Cannon, we destroy various objects consisting of pixel maps. Shoot bombs at objects and make the explosions bigger. Upgrade your Cannon with the money you earn and make it more effective and powerful! You can also earn much more money on Bonus Maps.

title: Angry Chibi Run
description: Angry Chibi RunAn endless sprinting running game. Jump and slide to avoid obstacles and dodge oncoming trains as fast as possible. Choose your favorite character, dress him up and surf the streets to your heart's content! What are you waiting for, come and join the best parkour game ever!

title: Baby Penguin Fishing
description: Tiny Fishing is a fun and addictive 2D puzzle fishing simulation game that challenges your skills. Enjoy this charming game as you explore a fishing adventure. The game has two modes: Fishing and Trawling. In Fishing mode, you cast your line by clicking on each fish’s body and catch them quickly to advance to the next level. In Trawling mode, you release the net by clicking on the desired area and capture everything within it. You also have to complete the objective fast.

title: Halloween Monster Traffic
description: Halloween is coming! The little monsters are ready to work! But the roads are full of cars! Can you help them find the right way? Tap the screen at the right time, and help them cross the road! Enjoy various fun obstacles and levels! What are you waiting for? Try this game! Have a spooky and happy Halloween! Have fun!

title: Christmas Spot the Difference
description: Dive into the holiday spirit with our "Christmas Spot the Difference" game! Uncover 5-10 distinctions between two identical festive scenes, but beware—each wrong click costs you 100 points. Race against the clock, as time is of the essence. Solve the puzzle before the timer hits zero to earn a delightful time bonus. Seek out holiday-themed nuances, from twinkling lights to subtle shifts in décor. Can you spot all the differences and triumph in this yuletide challenge? Merry spotting!

title: Stack Sorting
description: Welcome to Stack Sorting! Your task is to organize colorful cylinders by clicking on stacks. Move the topmost cylinder to an empty stack or one with a matching top cylinder. Navigate through Easy Mode with plenty of stacks and time, or challenge yourself in Hard Mode with fewer stacks. Complete all levels within the time limit to emerge victorious!

title: Auto Ninja
description:
Auto Ninja is the ultimate ninja platform game that dares you to conquer 41 trap-filled chambers with sharp reflexes and puzzle-solving skills. 

Your mission? Steal all three coins hidden in each chamber to unlock exclusive ninja skins and show off your mastery.

With simple but tight controls, dynamic level design, and a steady ramp in difficulty, Auto Ninja delivers an intense, addictive experience that tests your agility, timing, and wit. Play now and rise to the challenge!

title: Hidden Objects Bakery
description: Explore 6 charming bakery shops in this fun hidden object game! With 24 exciting levels, find 6 hidden bakery items in each shop before time runs out. Perfect for all ages, enjoy the challenge and discover delicious treats in every corner. Can you find them all before time runs out?

title: Mermaids Spot The Differences
description: Dive into an enchanting underwater world with "Mermaids: Spot The Differences"! Explore vibrant ocean scenes teeming with mermaids and sea creatures as you sharpen your observation skills to uncover subtle distinctions. Immerse yourself in the magic of the deep blue and embark on an adventure of keen-eyed discovery!

title: Cross the Road
description: Experience the classic arcade action of Crossy Road in Roblox style! Navigate through endless roads, rivers, and train tracks, dodging obstacles and aiming for the highest score. With its vibrant voxel-style graphics and simple yet challenging gameplay, it's a nostalgic journey for both new and seasoned players.

title: Chicken Banana Run
description: Explore the World and Space with the famous Chicken Banana! Run and keep running to collect gold, diamonds and special items and finish with the longest distance to get a high score! Play now the new free runner game for everyone.

title: Super Stock Stack
description: Super Stock Stack challenges you to sort food cans onto shelves with speed and clever organization! Match the cans by their labels, manage the growing stock, and test your skills as the levels get tougher. Can you become the ultimate stock master?

title: Rodha
description:
- Play 60 unique, hand-crafted levels!
- 9 Unique characters.
- 11 different and soothing color themes.
- Move through different portals.

Jump through the levels and avoid obstacles. Collect coins for later upgrades. There are cannons, moving saws, and many other contraptions to stop you in your tracks. When you die you’re returned to the last checkpoint.

#Rodha #Platformer

title: Hammer Master－Craft & Destroy!
description: Do you want to relax and smash everything you see with a huge hammer? In this free casual 3D game we have successfully combined the mechanics of merging, crafting weapons, destroying objects, etc. Click "Play" & relieve your stress by breaking all around!

title: Speed Run 3d
description: Race through glowing 3D tunnels in a fast, reflex-based runner. Read the patterns, react in a split second, and thread the gaps as speed ramps up. Simple one-touch controls keep the focus on pure flow while crisp neon visuals make every run feel clean and satisfying.

title: Vortex Ball
description: Roll through an ever-changing, vibrant tunnel filled with deadly obstacles and tricky hurdles. Test your reflexes as you dodge, weave, and survive as long as you can in this fast-paced infinite runner. Collect gems along the way and unlock 27 unique balls from the shop. With only 2 balls to start, every gem counts. The tunnel never ends, the colors keep shifting, and the challenge only gets harder. How far can you go? Compete for the highest score and prove your skills!

title: Interstellar Run
description:
The most epic space endless runner.

Move, rotate the platform and jump to avoid falling into the holes.

Don't get zapped by the lasers.

Keep running and exploring this beautiful space tunnel.

Let the music guide you.

title: Goo Slime Jump
description: Goo Slime Jump is a fun and relaxing casual game, tap to make the slime jump and make sure it reaches the finish line, the relaxing music and calm gameplay make you addicted.

title: Knife Master : Ball Racing
description:
Chop chop chop, throw the knife, but don't hit the ball~!
It's like the mastery of circus performer. Which means, it's fun! Let's be the master of throwing knives and bounce the ball to the sky!

title: Wheelie Cross
description:
Wheelie Cross is an easy-to-play game that will teach you how to do wheelies on all kinds of bikes. Try to keep your balance and tackle the obstacles along the way.  

Try to perform the longest wheelie ever as you collect coins and unlock new vehicles – a trial bike, a unicorn ride, a real chopper, a café racer, a steam-punk model, one for Fortnite fans, a shopping cart, a futuristic motorcycle, a scooter, an ATV, a vintage bike or a superbike.

title: Mr Reckless: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, Nitro to escape the impossible.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Mad Dash
description: Mad Dash is a free puzzle platform game.  You are a minotaur trapped in one of the last mazes in the galaxy: a maze of levels. You'll have to jump and dash over treacherous obstacles and challenges to make it through this maze. Many of the platforms are too far apart for you to make it with a simple jump. That is why the mad dash was created. The mad dash happens when players need to jump over spikes or a crevasse that their normal jump wouldn't traverse.

title: Call of the Jungle! Animal Evolution
description:
Feel like the king of the jungle in this casual 3D runner about wild animals. Feed your hungry pet only the right food so that it develops. Collect crystals, level up your character and become the king of beasts in this free online game!

Dive into the exciting world of animals, where your pet will become a real king of beasts. In this exciting casual online game, you have to feed your animal so that it can grow and evolve. Go through exciting races and challenges in the wild jungle.

title: Slope Snowball
description: Slope SnowBall is an intriguing endless-running game with a winter theme. Your aim is to roll a snowball as far as possible down slopes full of hazards!

title: Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles
description: Join a cosmic puzzle adventure where Tetriz meets pixel art. Place colorful Tetriz-style pieces on a grid to create shapes, ranging from easy to complex. Each piece has its own spot, adding to the challenge. Complete 45 levels, solving cosmic Tetriz puzzles in a space-themed setting. Can you beat this cosmic challenge before time's up?

title: Sling Drift
description: Master the art of drifting as you tackle every turn on an endless track! Sling your car around curves with precision and aim to go as far as possible in this thrilling 2D racing game. How long can you keep the momentum going without crashing? Test your reflexes and find out!

title: Onet Mahjong Connect
description: Onet Mahjong Connect is an easy and fun puzzle game where players match identical tiles. The goal is to connect two matching tiles. Tiles can be linked if they can be joined using three or fewer straight lines. With many levels to enjoy, the game offers a relaxing and engaging experience — perfect for taking a break and sharpening your mind!

title: Strawberry Hero
description: Stick your fork and climb to the top! Hold down to keep sticking the fork continuously. If your fork hits a hero or an obstacle, it’s game over! Stick the fork just above the falling hero’s feet to trigger a Super Jump and earn a high score!

title: Santa T Rex Run
description:
Play a cute and lovable T-Rex running across a desert.
Time your dino jumps to avoid the different obstacles.
How high can you score?
Features:
- Cool pixel artwork with T Rex dinosaur.
- Classic grayscale theme set in prehistoric era. Jump over a variety of plants and cactus.
- Easy to play, hard to master.
- The background accelerates and decelerates occasionally, to keep you on your toes.
- Responsive design with fullscreen capability

title: Escape From Tung Tung Sahur
description: Escape From Tung Tung Sahur is a fast-paced runner-platformer where quick reflexes are your only chance of survival! You play as a lone runner escaping the bizarre and relentless anomaly known as Tung Tung Sahur. Sprint across platforms, leap over deadly gaps, and avoid sudden obstacles. With intuitive one-touch controls, the game is easy to play but challenging to master. Each level introduces new platform layouts and jump timing that push your skills to the limit.

title: Geometry Flap
description:
Enter a world of bold outlines, sharp corners, and pure reflex. In Geometry Flap, you control a shapeshifting arrow darting through a black-and-white maze of geometric chaos. Tap to flap, weave through deadly gates, and dodge precision traps in this high-speed gauntlet of skill.

Features:
One mistake = instant crash.
Simple to play, brutally hard to master.
Unlock dozens of slick arrow skins.

Will you survive the rhythm of geometry?
Challenge your reflex. Flap to glory.

title: Roll Run 3D
description: Roll Run 3D is New Unique Concept with Rolling , Just Tap to Roll Ball and Reach Destination , Be Aware with Obstacles . Have Fun.

title: Train Surfers
description:
Endless running game, Run - Try Train Surfers, Run as fast as you can! Train Surfing is an amazing running game for runner. Run along the chaos complex traffic and escape from the police, you know how it is in street life.

Swipe to turn or use Direction keys or WASD for up, left, down and right respectively or use space bar for jump, jump and slide to avoid hitting obstacles, barrier buses and trains. Have exciting run on Bus 3D, collect coins and buy power up. Unlock new characters, and see how far you can run! Underground city adventure travel along the tracks start now,surf with your friends. Run like hell and challenge your limit. Run - Train Surfing  must be a very fun run game. Play it now and start your Run - Train Surfing, join the most thrilling dash.

title: Dart Hero
description: Do you have the reflexes of a Hero? Step up to the line in Dart Hero, the fast-paced arcade game where timing is everything. Forget about complex aiming—just wait for the perfect moment and Tap to Shoot!

title: Obby Flip
description:
It’s time to lose control over the Obby body like a ragdoll and flip-flip-flip to your bed!
In Obby Flip.  You should get ready to jump and fly through all the obstacles in your house to a bedroom. Watch out and don’t touch the floor! Collect cash and Diamonds and unlock new characters and complete all levels

title: Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure
description:
Cool orange ball went on an adventure in which evil stones beat him, but the orange ball has 3 hearts. The game is similar to mario and sonic.

Game Features:
- Lots of exciting levels
- Various biomes
- Secrets in some levels
- Skins of colorful balls

Did you like the game Cool Orange Ball: Bounce Adventure? - Then try our other games and write a review on what to improve or what game we should release next!

title: Digital Circus Find The Differences
description:
Step into the whimsical and wacky world of Digital Circus: Find The Differences, where fun meets challenge! Explore vibrant and surreal circus scenes filled with unique characters and zany details, all while sharpening your observation skills. Can you spot the subtle changes between two seemingly identical pictures?
Put your eyes to the test and discover how many differences you can find in this exciting puzzle adventure!

title: Blocky Archer Run
description:
Draw, Aim, and Loose!

Dash through challenging environments in this fast-paced, action-packed stickman adventure! Stick Archer Run combines endless running with precision archery. Test your reflexes as you sprint forward—all you have to do is aim your bow, time your shots, and take down enemies before they stop you. Simple to play, hard to master. How far can you run?

title: Sprunki 3D Shooter
description: Sprunki 3D Shooter delivers nonstop action as you face off against waves of Sprunkies! Your mission is simple: shoot to survive as long as you can. Run out of ammo? Search the battlefield for scattered rounds to keep the fight alive. Gear up and prepare to take on the Sprunkies—can you last the challenge?

title: Unicycle Balance 3D
description:
Balance, Pedal & Survive.

Enter the wacky and challenging world of Unicycle Balance 3D, a physics-based balancing game that tests your skill, patience, and reflexes! Guide your unicyclist across surreal landscapes, avoiding obstacles and mastering the delicate art of staying upright.

title: Emoji Frenzy
description: Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: Black Hole vs Monster
description: Black Hole is ready for battle against big monsters. Gather your army with your black hole and fight against bosses. Don't forget to upgrade the hole to fight bigger and stronger monsters! Let the fight begin.

title: Egg Farm
description:
Join the egg-citing adventure of Egg Farm and unleash your inner fox as you embark on a fast-paced egg-catching frenzy! 
Dash with lightning agility, master obstacle evasion, and craft a fox character like no other with a range of custom skins. It's time to become an egg-cellent egg-catching maestro - your prowess will earn you legendary status!

title: Shoot Block Rush 3D
description: Shoot Block Rush 3D is a simple and easy-to-use shooting game consisting of many small levels. It doesn't require you to have great shooting skills. You need to choose the right abilities and paths to win. Your goal is to keep shooting in all directions and clear all the obstacles that stand in your way. Try to be the best destroyer and defeat the boss!

title: Gun Rush
description: Fire off your epic selection of awesome guns to reach the end of each level while causing chaos and destruction! Amass coins to unlock more guns across endless levels of utter carnage!!!!! (╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻

title: Boxing Gang Stars
description: The stars are in the boxing ring and it is time to fight! These funny boxing characters are trying to destroy each other either in 1 player or in 2 player mode. Start this boxing competition and become the king of the boxing rings! Super fun physics with fun characters is waiting for you! Let the box fights begin!

title: COINs
description: A line of 10 coins with the same number changes to a coin with one higher number. Coins can be moved anywhere, even to empty lines or on coins with different numbers. You can add coins at any time. The game is cleared if you make a coin with the number 10! The faster the clear time, the higher the score.

title: Stunt Car Extreme 2
description: Experience the exhilarating thrill of Stunt automobile Extreme 2, a remarkable 3D game that offers free access. Engage in extreme automobile driving on very challenging courses, which include moving platforms suspended in the sky. Navigate over intense obstacles and sharp bends to test your skills to the limit.

title: Drunk Man 3D
description: Drunk Man 3D is a challenging and comedic 3D Ragdoll Physics game. In this game, players must navigate a treacherous cityscape while emulating the hindered balance of inebriation. The game features ragdoll physics, where even minor collisions can cause players to lose control and stumble.

title: Santa Parkour
description:
Santa now delivers presents via parkour. Jump on snowy rooftops while avoiding obstacles in this exciting fresh take on parkour.

Tap to jump high. Feel the rush of flying through the air, then execute sick rolls as you land.

Unlock different kinds of moves by collecting skill cards. Do different kinds of flips as Santa.

title: Mineblock Obby
description: Minecraft Obby is an amazing parkour game that you can play totally free! Do your best as you navigate through challenging obstacle courses, avoiding pitfalls and traps along the way. Collect coins scattered throughout each level to buy yourself a new sword and enhance your gameplay experience. With each jump and sprint, you'll improve your skills and push your limits. Dive into the blocky world of Minecraft Obby, avoid obstacles, collect those coins, and most importantly—have fun!

title: Z Stick Duel Fighting
description: Join the ultimate stickman battle in Z Stick Duel Fighting, a game that will make you fight for glory. You will play as a stickman warrior who must face other stickmen from across the universe. Can you win this duel competition? Various exciting and handsome skills are waiting for you to try! Calculate the amount of mana, avoid the enemy's attacks, and deliver a fatal blow! You are the stickman fighting king of the universe!

title: Mini Fighters Strike
description: 8 talented mini fighters are ready to show their skills in the arena. Follow your opponent and try to win matches by making the right moves at the right time. Mini Fighters Strike can be played by 1 and 2 player. You can join the tournament and show who is the leader.

title: Impossible Parkour
description:
Are you ready for the impossible challenges and levels in this Impossible Parkour game?
Every level has its unique experience and at every level you will experience new things with 25 levels of the game. You can play it all the day but never finish the game. Let's see if you can?

title: Bouncy Bomb Buddies
description: Bouncy Bomb Buddies is a high-energy, sugary-sweet 1v1 artillery platformer where cute characters battle it out in vibrant, candy-colored arenas. Your goal? Bounce around platforms, grab falling bombs, and launch them at your opponent to be the last buddy standing! It combines fast-paced movement with tactical throwing physics and a best-of-5 rounds system to crown the supreme champion.

title: Sky Ball
description: Roll fast on the platforms! Take boosts to gain speed and momentum! Fly in the air as long as you can to improve your score and showcase your skills! Watch out for tricky gaps and obstacles, and whatever you do, don't fall down! Stay focused, and see how far you can go!

title: Nail Challenge
description: This time the challenge begins with a wood piece, a nail, and a hammer. Create your own team and start nailing the nails into the woods! You should nail before your opponent's team. Don't miss chances on golden nails to get more power. Various characters in the shop will be waiting. Make sure you create the strongest team. Between the levels you will play some bonus levels, try to smash as much wood with your hammer and nail and get as many bonus game coins as you can!

title: Slope Spooky
description: Slope Spooky is a Halloween-themed! A ball rolling down difficult and eerie slopes is controlled by the players. It's almost Halloween, which means Slope needs some scary stuff!

title: Santa Run
description: Help Santa deliver the presents in this crazy running game. Race down the city streets avoiding all of the obstacles as you try to score as many points as possible. We hope you enjoy this endless Christmas themed running game.

title: Black Jump
description: Escape the war-torn planet in this dynamic jump-and-run game. Sprint through the desolate landscape, vanquish enemies, sidestep deadly traps, and gather valuable crystals.

title: Push The Colors
description: Push the Color game features colorful squares, obstacles, and color gates. It is a 2-player casual game where you can find various costumes during the adventure. The goal is to get the cubes to the finish line and challenge the giant at the end. The more cubes you have, the more power you will possess. You can defeat the color monster by having many cubes. Make wise choices along the way and increase the number of cubes in your possession.

title: Skibidi Dash
description: Have fun and take control of the Skibidi toilet guy and go as far as you can, show that you can against this hard infinity game full of deadly obstacles and challenges !!!! Complete all levels and unlock new characters to continue the journey. Play Skibidi Dash now totally free and enjoy many hours of entertainment.

title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
description:
Tap on the screen, that will make the ball bounce higher and higher. The ball has one color, and can pass through obstacle with the same color, or sneak in between obstacles with different colors.

Easy-to-play and addictive !

title: 2048 Runner
description:
Navigate through a series of gates and cubes, avoid the negative gates and go in the positive ones and merge to the same cube, but avoid the cubes with different number, you can't merge with them.
You must arrive at the end of level with a number that is greater than or equal to the level's objective.
With fast reflexes and strategic thinking, you must outwit the negative gates and keep their number from reaching zero in order to make it through each level and ultimately win the game.

title: Number Jumping
description: Remove all of the numbered boxes on each level by reducing their count to zero.  A box's number is reduced by one each time your player, the green box, jumps on it so plan your jumps carefully.  It's a challenge to complete all 35 levels.

title: Tiny Alien
description:
Jump and shoot your way through space!
Can you defeat the evil empire and bring back the sacred gems? Fast paced arcade platforming action with sweet pixel graphics!
Music by Boy vs Bacteria! Power-ups! Bosses! Unlock different characters! You are our only hope Tiny Alien! Good Luck!

title: Choco Blocks
description: Enter the delightful world of Choco Blocks, a tantalizing puzzle adventure where strategy meets sweetness! In this engaging game, your task is to pick and drop sets of blocks to complete rows. But there’s a sweet twist: special chocolate blocks are hidden within the rows, waiting to be collected. Your mission is to strategically arrange the blocks and collect all the specific choco blocks from the board before time runs out.

title: Obby 3D Sprunki Parkour
description: Obby 3D Sprunki Parkour combines the best elements of obstacle challenges and parkour gameplay in an immersive 3D environment. The goal? Navigate through increasingly complex levels filled with moving platforms, tricky jumps, and narrow ledges while collecting coins and power-ups along the way. Each level offers unique challenges that test your timing, reflexes, and problem-solving skills.

title: Tung Tung Sahur Coloring Book
description:
Unleash your creativity with the Italian Tung Coloring Book, a hilarious and surreal coloring experience inspired by the viral Italian Brainrot meme phenomenon. Featuring absurd characters like Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala, and Bombardiro Crocodilo, this coloring book offers a unique blend of humor and art.
Each page presents a bizarre and whimsical scene, inviting you to add your personal touch with colors.

title: Stack Crash Ball
description:
Stack Crash Ball is a 3d casual game where players smash, bump and bounce through revolving helix stacks to reach the end.
Sound easy? You wish!!
Your ball smashes like a brick through colorful stacks that block its descent, but if you hit a black one, it's all over! Your ball shatters to pieces and you have to start your fall all over again.
But even black stacks are no match for a fireball falling at full speed! Choose your strategy: speed up like a madman or stop and wait for your next chance to roll and jump.

Stack Crash Ball is a super fun and addictive one touch casual game.
Press and hold on the screen and let the ball go down without touching the obstacles! Hold as long as possible to make combo and break the black stacks. Let the ball fall down from the helix stacks.

title: Grocery Shop: Supermarket Game
description: Run and manage your own supermarket in this engaging simulation game. Stock shelves, serve customers, manage inventory, and expand your store to build a successful grocery business. Handle the rush of customers while keeping products organized and priced competitively to maximize profits.

title: We Are In A Simulation Simulator
description: We Are In A Simulation Simulator challenges you to question nothing and mimic everything. Blend in by copying the actions of others to survive in a strange digital world where free will doesn’t exist. Stay alert, follow the crowd, and don’t get caught acting out of sync. Play for free online on mobile or desktop and test your ability to conform in this mysterious simulation!

title: Ace Car Racing
description: Ace Car Racing offers high-octane city-avoidance action. Choose from sleek 3D modern sports cars across Seaside Roads, Exotic, City Racing, and Desert Trip. Collect lightning items for fuel, coins for upgrades, or splurge on new cars. Remember: diamonds unlock special vehicles. Invest in a superior car upfront and fine-tune its Acceleration, Max Speed, Wind Resistance, and Nitrogen. Skip the starter car—your race to victory awaits!

title: Music Rush
description:
Music Rush is a 1-tap infinite and rhythmic runner where you play with iconic music stars and try to reach the highest stage in your career, while the song and the scenery evolve as you reach higher scores.

Try out 15 original songs and find out the genre you that fits you best!
- Electronic
- Rock
- Disco
- Pop
- K-Pop
- Classic
- Samba
- Latina
- Reggae
- Rap
- Medieval
- Dungeon
- Country

Try out amazing power-ups that affect your musical experience and much more!

title: Miner's Fury!
description:
Miner's Fury! Avoid and destroy!

Clear and destroy rock waves. Lookout for mystery rocks too! Buy and deploy Turrets to breeze through levels. 
Collect the coins that drop from the destroyed rocks, and spend them buying Turrets, and to Upgrade yourself. Upgrades will make you deal more damage faster, earn more coins, as well as improving your spawned Turrets.
Lookout for Missions to earn rewards!

Made with ❤️ by Realinspirer

title: Mad Truck Driving
description: Do you love driving trucks and crushing cars? Then you will enjoy Mad Truck Driving, the best 2D driving game ever! This game lets you drive a powerful truck through various obstacles and challenges! You will be amazed by the interesting graphics and exciting sound effects! Don’t worry about the cars in front of you, just smash them with your truck! Your truck is unstoppable! But can you overcome the different obstacles and complete the levels? Try Mad Truck Driving now and start your adventure!

title: Bear vs Humans
description: Play as a crazy bear in this exciting 3D game! Ride a log with squirrels, destroy campsites, destroy objects and trees, and scare people with a loud roar. Use squirrels as throwing weapons and create chaos in the forest! Dive into a fun and wild world full of destruction and adventure!

title: Toy Cars: 3D Racing
description: Jump into the car and participate in this racing experience. Compete with other racers, participate in various challenges and time-limited events. Prepare your car and drift. Upgrade your carriage. The engine, tires and chassis improve the overall performance of your car.

title: Slime Rush
description: Join the colorful adventure of *Slime Rush*! Control a lively group of slimes as you race along challenging paths, avoiding obstacles and growing your slimes. Collect gems to unlock unique skins and power-ups. Can you lead your slimes to victory? Start your journey in *Slime Rush* today!

title: Circular Spiral Jump
description: Your job is to run on spiral platform without falling down. You have to avoid other obstacles too.

title: Retro Street Fighter
description: Travel back in time with Retro Street Fighter, a side-scrolling fighting game that will make you feel nostalgic. This game features 2D-pixel art that gives it a classic look. You will fight your way through multiple levels, facing different enemies and showing off your skills. You can choose from seven levels of difficulty and challenge yourself. You will also have various moves to use in combat, such as punches, kicks, and blocks. But be careful, some enemies are tough and dangerous.

title: Gate Heroes Battle
description: Embark on a journey with your cute monsters and go through positive gates to build up your strength. This will help you defeat stronger enemies. Also watch out for traps and obstacles in your way. Try to reach your strongest form to defeat the final boss.

title: Go Go Panda
description: Help the panda gather coins and run as far as possible! Avoid arrows, roll through caves and jump over obstacles to stay alive. Set a highscore and break it! Become the best panda runner there is!

title: Run Santa!
description: Run with Santa as far as you can. Pick sweet candy sticks to increase score and springs to perform in-air jumps.

title: Okay
description: Okay is a minimalist puzzle game where your goal is to clear every element from the board by drawing a single strategic line. Each line you draw interacts with the objects on screen — if it hits them correctly, they disappear. The challenge lies in predicting the trajectory and eliminating everything with just one attempt.

title: Spooky Run
description:
Run and collect more sweets than you can on the scariest night of the year!!
Beware for the dangers or your run will end, but at least you can enjoy your candies.
Unlock a special character with all your candies and beat you highscore!

title: SantaDays Christmas
description: Santa Days : Christmas Finish dozens of courses and collect crowns. Be the winner of the day! Buy the costumes and change your image. Race with 10-40 people, be the winner of the race! Join the world of Fall Days. Race with different costumes on different maps! Make the Difference.

title: Family Squid Challenge
description: Hey Player, bring your friend along and team up in this Squid adventure! There are black and red masked men everywhere, so you must be very careful. Run from them and collect the keys to complete the level. Be cautious — both of you need to survive!

title: Spin Thru
description:
Fit the piece perfectly before the hole arrives!
Tap to rotate! Swipe left or right to flip!
When it’s ready, swipe up to send it through the hole.
Keep succeeding in a row to trigger Fever!
During Fever, easier puzzles will appear for a limited time!

title: Sword Run 3D
description: Sword Run 3D is an easy to pick up action runner game. Collect sword pieces, cut off the obstacles that block your progress, and finally reach the finish line to win. More cool skins are waiting for you to unlock, what are you waiting for? Don't forget to share it with your friends if it's fun!

title: Angry Flappy
description: "Angry Flappy is a fast-paced twist on the classic game, where players not only navigate through obstacles but also shoot bullets to destroy enemies and barriers. Get ready for an action-packed flying adventure!"

title: Quiz Squid Round
description: Dive into the trivia world with Quiz Squid Game. This unique game puts your knowledge of the popular series to test. Not just about general knowledge, but the devil is in the details of this mysterious and thrilling TV show. Get ready to answer questions about plot twists, characters, and little known facts about-in game universe. Impress your friends with your trivia skills and detailed memory of this cinema spectacle.

title: Paint Roller
description: Control two tethered spheres in this unique painting challenge. Click to anchor one sphere in place while the other swings around it on an elastic tether, leaving a dynamic paint trail. Your objective? Strategically rotate your tethered pair to completely coat all target cylinders in each level.

title: Shadow Stickman Fight
description: Shadow Stickman Fight is an awesome and intense 2D ninja survival arcade game. You have to survive the endless waves of enemies with stickman ninjas. Every time you pass a belt exam, you get the examiner’s hat and weapon. You can use souls to trade items or earn gifts. You have to follow the white dots and hit the enemies. You have to time your attack when enemies are in your attack distance. You can also enter the arsenal and choose different equipment, like helmets and weapons.

title: Touchdown Master
description: Are you ready, as a qualified football player, to start a different kind of competition, the local cup football competition? You will need to successfully dodge obstacles, as well as disruptive players, and successfully collect more coins and keys. At the end of the game, throw the ball far enough to get more gold.

title: Santa City Run
description: Guide Santa along the city streets avoiding obstacles along the way Jump over cars side step traffic codes and avoid blockades Boost your points by collecting Christmas giftsHow many points can you scoreFeatures Christmas theme suitable for families D like environment Collect elves to gain a temporary bubble shield A cool shop to purchase upgrades for Santa Includes a hoverboard segway skateboard and a rocket booster to pump up the xmas mood

title: Run Panda Run
description: Is time to go home for this panda and he wants to collect as much coins as possible. Avoid obstacle and reach the end on this one click game adventure

title: InsectaQuest-Adventures
description: InsectaQuest-Adventure: Explore a world of hidden wonders, embark on thrilling insect-catching adventures, and solve shadowy mysteries. Spin the wheel to win coins and unlock the enchanting 'Magic Magnifying Glass' to reveal hidden treasures and secrets!

title: Chroma Trek
description:
Dive into the glowing world of Chroma Trek, a vibrant neon platformer where every step is a test of skill and perception. With dazzling visuals and a unique color-switching mechanic, each level feels like a handcrafted puzzle filled with dynamic challenges.

Shift colors to phase through obstacles, stay sharp to dodge traps, and be inspired by motivational messages that guide you along the way. Your goal? Reach the shimmering Finish Crystal and conquer every stage with style.

title: Steal Items io
description:
Grab everything in your hands and steal items!
You play for a flexible and funny stickman who can't stand on his feet straight. You need to run faster to the largest and most expensive items in the houses, grab them and deliver them to the truck.
You have to steal a lot of items, because besides you, there are other stickmen running around the house who also want to rob this house. Beat them on points and collect more furniture.

title: Pull the Pin Rescue
description: Pull the Pin Rescue is a rescue game that you need to pull out the pin in the right order and rescue a trapped guy. Once failed the young guy will be dangerous. Focuses more on your strategy and saves him.

title: Balanced Running
description: Time to show your skills by making a puppet walk in the Balanced Running game! This walk will be a little hard at first. You should decide how long you need to hold the button very carefully. If you hold too much the character will make a long step and this may cause fail. Try to make your steps balanced and get the character to the finish! You can play this challenge in 2 player mode and have much more fun with your friend! Let's get it begun!

title: FlyWay Duo Race
description: A Duo Race is beginning on the Flying Way by controlling casual-style cars in two player game mode! The main goal at this race is to get to the longest distance with your car. During your journey, you can collect the diamonds on your way. The diamonds will let you buy new cars on the shop menu. Jump over the ramps, fly as long as you can, and avoid obstacles on your way. Let the race begin!

title: Survival Sword Battle
description: Survival Sword Battle throws you into a ruthless sword-fighting free-for-all battle where a single hit means defeat. Fight to unlock all 10 character evolutions and boost your speed with each upgrade. Can you dominate the leaderboard and survive the longest?

title: Pen Run 2
description: What better way to drawing pictures that play Pen Run 2? New adventure begin! Avoiding obstacles, and collect the ink pots to fill with life's to paint a beautiful pictures. More then 30 interesting levels are waiting for you!

title: Void Orbit
description: Void Orbit is an addictive space arcade game where you orbit a central core and dodge incoming enemies. Tap to reverse direction and survive as long as possible! Unlock cool skins, dynamic themes, enjoy challenging modes like Echo Mirage and Tower Build. Multi-language support for global players. Free to play, endless fun!

title: Pushover 3D
description: Unleash your creativity in *Pushover 3D*! Draw unique curves to control your ragdoll fighter’s moves, launching them in unexpected ways to defeat opponents. Each match is a wild, physics-based showdown where every line transforms into unpredictable body motions. From wild spins to slingshot leaps, it’s all up to the patterns you create. Experiment, outsmart your rivals, and become a master of ragdoll combat!

title: Labuba Halloween Infestation
description: Monsters are invading Halloween! You must destroy them all — the fate of Halloween is in your hands. The game features three different modes, each with tougher and more powerful monsters.

title: Tap Candy : Sweets Clicker
description: Have you ever dreamed of producing tons of candies for children and parents ? If yes, play this super game now, and become the best candy artisan in your sweet factory. Tap as fast as you can, select and upgrade your production tools to build more. Ready for this candy challenge ? Easy-to-play and addictive !

title: Agent Squad
description:
Looking for an engaging casual shooter that’s easy to get the hang of but offers engrossing action and real tactical challenges? 
Agent Squad is a top-down shooting game with intelligent mechanics, loads of cool upgradable guns, and addictive gameplay

title: Horror Forest Bear
description: Imagine an angry bear that has escaped from its cave in the forest. It's very hungry and wants to eat honey. You must help the bear. The bear is starving, and it needs to eat all the honey. You need to be very careful—it's a dark and dangerous forest, full of traps and hunters. The hunters have become much stronger because they can shoot with guns now. You must avoid the hunters. Escape from them, collect all the honey, and return to the bear's cave.

title: Mega Jump
description: Mega Jump is a fast-paced vertical arcade game where you leap from platform to platform, collect coins, and dodge hazards as you climb higher. Power-ups, shifting coins, and colorful boost stars keep every ascent exciting. With vibrant visuals and responsive movement, the challenge grows as you push for your highest score without missing a single platform.

title: Falling Ball 3D
description: Falling Ball 3D is fun game with freefall gameplay. Pass the obstacles and reach the end of the levels. Have fun in this challenging game. Have fun in this qute game!

title: Neon Gravity
description:
Defy gravity in this intense neon-soaked arcade runner! In Neon Gravity, your goal is to survive as long as possible by switching gravity to avoid deadly spikes, saws, and mines.

Master the timing to pass safely between rotating gears and trigger the "Perfect" bonus for massive points. As your score increases, the game speeds up, testing your reflexes to the limit. Can you unlock all 10 unique skins, including the Ninja and the Eye?

title: Space Run
description: Escape from the meteorites. Get the highest score. But watch out, don't hit nails.

title: Fashion Style Run 3D
description: Do you like Girls games? Great, Fashion Style Run 3D game waiting for you. Collect the things that make money on the track and reach the richness as soon as possible. There is a great car waiting for you at the finish line.

title: Coe Snake
description: Coe Snake brings the classic snake game with new challenges! Collect fruits, dodge meteors, walls, bombs, and balls that move like ping pong. Multiple modes, scenarios, and fruits to choose from. Fast-paced, colorful, and addictive — how far can you go?

title: Turbo Car Track
description: Get ready for an exhilarating ride with Turbo Car Track! Navigate through winding tracks that get progressively more challenging as your speed increases. Collect gold coins to unlock new, more powerful vehicles and boost your progress. Can you handle the speed and conquer the track? Find out in this thrilling, high-speed adventure!

title: Santa Claus Rush
description: Santa Claus Rush is fun and addicting arcade game suitable for all ages.  You need to stay alive as long time as possible and collect as many gifts as posssible. Jump and avoid incoming rockets. Many children are waiting for the christmas gift so collect as many as possible. We are counting on you, dear Santa! Have fun playing.

title: BAT!zo Runner
description: Become the cutest vampuuurrr bat! Fly, dodge, and collect mysterious red potions in BAT!zo - new addictive endless runner!

title: Fruitfall Catcher
description: Test your reflexes by catching fruits each level everything is faster and different, how far can you reach? but be careful of the bombs!

title: Gloves Grow Rush
description: “Gloves Grow Rush” is a 3D arcade game where you control stickman boxers in a vertical running challenge. Collect boxing gloves, battle weaker opponents, and take on the final boss at each level. If you encounter a stronger boxer, evade rather than fight to survive. Beware: a direct punch means game over! Claim gems to upgrade your starting level and attack power (ATK). The shop offers 6 unique boxing gloves, but they don’t grant extra ATK or levels. Best of luck!

title: Skibidi StickBloons
description: Skibidi Stickbloons is a highly addictive puzzling skill game that will have you begging for the best fun.  Help the Skibidi guy pop all the balloons in every arena and complete them all. Some levels require precision, some require skill and others require puzzle solving skills. One thing is for certain though popping Bloons is so much fun!

title: Ship Control 3D
description: Get ready for an exhilarating ship sailing adventure in Ship Stack Racing, a 3D arcade game that will challenge your skills. You have to dodge various obstacles and make it to the beach in one piece. But watch out, as any collision will end your run. Ship Stack Racing is a game that will make your heart race and your adrenaline pump.

title: Bouncing Chick
description: In Bouncing Chick you have to reach your nest as fast as you can, avoiding obstacles and hazards. Go to the top of the level and try to beat your record! There are 24 levels to beat, so what are you waiting for? Start your climbing to the top!

title: Cube Stack 2048
description:
Cube Stack 2048 is a highly addictive casual game inspired by the classic puzzle game 2048, but with exciting new gameplay!
Merge numbered cubes to double their value, reach 2048, or even higher! Try to make it to the end.
