Explore tons of amazing and challenging levels by merging cubes, avoiding obstacles, and collecting money!

title: Two Carts - Downhill
description: Two Carts - Downhill is a fast-paced arcade game where you control two carts simultaneously, each on its own obstacle-filled road. Use the left and right arrow keys to steer each cart independently, collecting components to score points. Pick up power-ups like Ice to slow down the game or Shield to protect against obstacles. As you progress, the game speeds up, challenging your reflexes and multitasking skills. How long can you keep both carts on track?

title: Christmas Rush
description: Santa's terribly late for delivering gifts! Help him picking gift packs to give to good children. Avoid obstacles along the way to survive as long as possible. Collect the glittering stars to get a magical power-up!

title: Chicken Wild Run
description: Aim for the goal while collecting coins! Tap to change direction left and right. When your stamina runs out, the game is over. Get a kiss from a cute girl and become invincible! In invincible mode, you can bounce off obstacles. If you collect 10 mysterious bottles, the coins on the road will turn into high-scoring diamonds for a certain period of time.

title: LampHead
description: The main character of this game is an amazing man with a lamp instead of a head who needs to get out of a dark and dangerous strange place at any cost. Are you ready to prove that you have an outstanding reaction, maneuvering between sharp obstacles, collecting bonuses, remembering that at the end of each dark path the light of victory awaits you? We are ready to offer you a one-time runner in which tedious jumps are replaced by moving the main character between two equal planes.

title: Vehicle Fun Race
description: Vehicle Fun Race—an exhilarating arcade game with 3D stickman characters. Collect motorcycles, cars, boats, and helicopters to reach the finish line. No need to grab vehicles; your character can handle all terrains. Dive into water? No problem—control their swim. Special helicopters await on final platforms. Ready to race? Let’s roll!

title: Blue VS Red
description: Sort blue and red items as fast as you can! Drag or use arrow keys to send each item to the correct zone. Build combos, beat the timer, and earn coins to buy power-ups. Challenge yourself in solo mode or compete against AI bots. How high can you score in 30 seconds?

title: Helicopter Battle Steve 2 Player
description: Get on the helicopter and choose either the blue or red player. Destroy your friend’s helicopter to win the game.Winning is simple: just don’t let your helicopter crash! Jump and shoot to defeat your opponent. To beat the red or blue player, you must play your best. The player whose helicopter explodes the most will lose the game.

title: Lava Ladder Leap
description:
Lava Ladder Leap: A thrilling endless runner where players climb a castle tower escaping rising lava. Dodge traps and compete against friends in single or 2player local multiplayer modes. Survive as long as possible or be the last one standing.

Game Modes:
Single-Player: In this mode, players must survive for as long as possible.

Two-Player: This competitive mode pits two players against each other. The first player to fall into the lava loses, and the remaining player emerges victorious.

title: Spin Shot Siege
description: In "Spin Shot Siege," take control of a gunner on a rotating tower. Enemy tanks orbit around you in the opposite direction. Each level has tanks following paths like diamonds, circles, rectangles, or triangles. Aim carefully and destroy all tanks before running out of ammo. Can you master the spin and win the siege?

title: Skyscraper to the Sky
description: Challenge your skills as an engineer and architect in this  puzzle game. Build the tallest, most stable skyscraper across 30 levels, from small houses to huge buildings.

title: Christmas Santa Claus Rush
description: Christmas is coming Santa Claus going to give the kids gifts please help him send holiday gifts for kids nowWhenever pass you will get a mystery giftA total of  mysterious Christmas gifts can you get it all Come and challenge I believe you can

title: Run Santa Run
description:
Run Santa Run is fun addictive running game.You should beat the monsters and collect as many gifts as you can.Press E to hit the monster with the sack.Press space to throw the bomb and use up arrow key to jump.
How to Play:
Press E to hit the monster with the sack.Press space to throw the bomb and use up arrow key to jump.

title: Cube Ninja
description: Welcome, little ninja! Switch gravity with just a touch /click, and avoid obstacles. Remember to get some Sushi bonus for extra points!

title: Christmas Ski
description: Christmas is almost here, you have to help Thomas collect gifts to give to Santa. Santa Claus is really tired this year, so you'll have to save the day and collect as many gifts as you can and as a reward, Santa said you could use some of the gifts and turn them into money to buy some cool and new clothes and skis for Thomas.

title: Lipstick Collector Run
description: Lipstick Collector Run is a classic vertical arcade game with a single-button control. Your mission: collect all the lipstick parts while dodging obstacles and earn money. Unlock marked levels by completing 8 wraps. Use money to draw 8 different colors. Earn extra cash with 8 hands that boost your lipstick collection. The more lipsticks you gather, the more money you’ll make!

title: Circle Shooter Master
description: Circle Shooter Master is a cool and exciting game about destroying the boss in the circle. You run in circles, shoot the boss, get materials, build towers, defend roadblocks and grab things that fall on the circle. You have to watch out for the boss’s attack and kill him before he hurts you. Join the game now!

title: Climate Activist
description: The player of this game is a Climate Activist and she wants to do some funny acts at the art galleries.She has lots of materials in her hands like eggs, tomatoes, stickers, spray paints, etc. and she is going to use them all in this art. The only thing that you need to be careful about is not being detected by the watchers in the art gallery. Let this super exciting and funny adventure begin!

title: Air Block
description:
Jump, Place Blocks, and Conquer Challenging Levels!

In Air Block, use quick reflexes and smart block placement to overcome obstacles and enemies. With limited blocks per level, every move counts! Avoid saws, spikes, and unlock doors to progress—plus, grab those bananas if you can!

Game Modes:

Single Player – Test your skills across unique levels.
Two-Player Mode – Compete in quick place challenges and mini-games like Beach Ball, with more to come!
Think you’ve got what it takes? Start now!

title: Running Santa
description: Santa Claus need to pass all levels in this game and to collect gifts for all kids of the world. Your job is to help Santa to do all tasks and to get him safe to the finish. Jump over obstacles, avoid rocks and other objects that can hurt Santa. Jump on trampoline for longer jumps. Walk thru platforms and collect all gifts. Pass all levels and have fun.

title: Shotting Balls
description: In this fun game, you'll have to use your skills to destroy all the black blocks you find in each level in order to advance to the next one. But that's not all: you'll also have to avoid losing the ball, because if it leaves the screen, you'll lose a life and, ultimately, the game. On the other hand, you can also collect gems, which will allow you to obtain new skins to give your ball a new look.

title: Squid Escape But Blockworld
description: You need to escape from the Squid competition, but while running away, you fell into the Block world. It’s a bit hard to escape from the Block world, but don’t stop and keep running. Never stop running until you reach the purple portal. Don’t forget to collect the money you see on the way. Be careful of the big monsters chasing you from behind; they want to catch you, and if they do, you’ll lose.

title: Tied Up
description: Tied Up is a physics-based arcade survival game where you control a small ball tethered to a larger one by a spring. Use momentum and precise mouse movements to swing, evade, and counter waves of enemies. With only three lives per round, survival demands quick reflexes and smart play. Rack up high scores and push for a new personal best!

title: Froggy Hop
description: Froggy Hop is a fun, physics-based game where you launch a bouncy frog and help it travel across lily pads, turtles, and spring pads while dodging obstacles. Upgrade jump power, height, and bounce to go farther. Unlock cool skins with upgrades, complete daily missions, and aim for the best distance!

title: Jump Man
description: A highly addictive endless jumper with a super cute but mischievous character! Chain combos and score as high as you can!

title: Space Shift
description: It's a game where you travel in space for as long as possible without hitting any obstacles- meteorites or missiles. Your ship moves automatically and you can slow it down to ensure it doesn't hit anything. There are different galaxies to travel through different in appearance and the type of obstacles to appear. If you travel far enough, you may encounter even an alien ship!

title: Super Slime
description: Super Slime is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a squishy, bouncy hero on a mission to save the day. Master the art of stretching, bouncing, and dodging through 100 thrilling levels packed with tricky obstacles and fierce enemies. Precision and quick reflexes are your best allies in this adorable yet challenging adventure!

title: Spider Bubu
description: Spider-Bubu swings from wall to wall across the city. Halloween has arrived, and you need to collect all the Halloween candies along with Spider-Bubu. Don’t forget to grab the giant pumpkin too! You must be very careful in the city — sharp spinning blades and pointed spikes are everywhere. Collect all the pumpkins and safely reach the portal that appears in the city.

title: Christmas Gravity Tree
description:
Gravity Tree is a christmas themed runner in oldshool style.

This game is crazy. Why? You are a running tree with the ability to change the gravity!

title: School Fun Differences
description: Here's a fun way to pass the time on a road trip, while waiting at the doctor's office, or justf for fun. Find all 5 differences in each level to enter a new one? No time limit, no rush. Have fun!

title: Running Ted
description: Run longer than anyone else. Discover Ted's wonderful world.

title: Sweet Truck
description: This is collecting game where you need to collect more cookies as you can in one level. Earn points and try not to crash. Control the truck with arrow keys or click on the buttons on your screen if you play on your cell phone. Pass all levels it is easy and fun.

title: Over the Rainbow
description: Help Alex the Elf return the colors to the rainbow by jumping. Avoid enemies and find power ups to aid you in your quest.

title: Christmas Parkour Santa
description: Help Santa deliver gifts to sleeping children Collect coins by jumping and avoiding hazardous objects

title: Wind Soldier
description: Embark on a survival mission as an elite soldier, parachuting into a warzone. Capture shields to face deadly challenges and complete your missions successfully!

title: MathPup Story
description: MathPup is through with math for the day and is off looking for dog bones. Help MathPup get the dog bone in each level in this platform puzzle game by having MathPup Strategically push and pull boxes so that MathPup can safely get to the dog bone's location.

title: Alphabet Jump
description: Alphabet Jump is game where you can learn alphabet in interesting way. You need to jump on alphabet letters in the correct order and to get to the finish on this game. Jump over letters and have fun. Control the player with click on mouse.

title: Desert car
description:
A "Shoot and jump" style game in which we drive a car in the desert equipped with a missile launcher.  
You start with 3 lives, the road is long, you have to be fast

title: Santa Xmas
description: Xmas is coming. Santa need candys for childrens. Help Santa to collect more candys to all childrens but be carefull, snow Yeti keep that candys for them. Good luck!

title: Swim Good
description: Chomp your way through a swirling feast of worms while dodging deadly spiky firing urchins! Stay alive, keep circling, and see how long you can last.

title: Christmas Panda Run
description: christmas panda run

title: HalloweenWheel
description: Ride all the meters you can with your pumpkin mounted on a unicycle in this physics gamePretty graphics and BSO Original by Guillermo CaeteEasy to play hard to masterSpecially created for halloween

title: Avocado Mother
description:
Embark on a fun and challenging adventure with Avocado Mother, a game designed for kids where you control a brave avocado seed on its epic journey through a chaotic kitchen full of obstacles.

* Objective: Help the seed overcome each challenge and reach its final destination—the hollow inside the avocado, where it belongs.

* Features:

Simple and accessible controls for kids.
